in_sanskrit.name: सम्रिद्धि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word 'Samriddhi' is derived from the root 'Ridh' which means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. The prefix 'Sam' in Samriddhi denotes 'all' or 'complete', hence the name Samriddhi means 'complete prosperity' or 'all-round wealth'.

in_hindi.name: सम्रिद्धि
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name 'Samriddhi' translates to 'सम्पूर्ण धन' which means 'complete wealth' or 'all-round prosperity'.

in_tamil.name: சம்ரித்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name 'Samriddhi' translates to 'ஓர் சமுத்திரம் போர்' which means 'a person who has everything' or 'one who possesses all wealth'.

in_telugu.name: శమ్రిధి
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name 'Samriddhi' translates to 'శమీఖ్యముదేశము' which means 'one who has all desires fulfilled' or 'one who possesses all wealth'.

in_marathi.name: Samriddhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Prosperity, Wealth, Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samriddhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Samriddhi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Samriddh’, which means ‘abundant’, ‘prosperous’, or ‘rich’. This name is believed to bring good fortune, wealth, and success to the bearer.
